title: Relative-spectrum characterization of quasi-affine morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Say that $f$ is quasi-affine [def-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism] when for every affine open $U\subseteq S$, the open subscheme $f^{-1}(U)$ is isomorphic to a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme. Then $f$ is quasi-affine if and only if there exist a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebra $\mathcal A$ (a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]), and a quasi-compact open immersion $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], where $\pi:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\to S$ is the relative spectrum [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec], such that $\pi\circ i=f$.
